description: Eight-direction character experiment; four new modular sheets generated with built-in imagegen from owner's approved east character.
prompt_common:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a production modular 2D game character sprite parts atlas on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Reference 1 is the identity and outfit, reference 2 shows intended small in-game pixel density. Create a NEW viewing angle of precisely this same adult male forest scavenger, brown short hair, short stubble, muted olive jacket, rust-red small scarf, brown trousers with knee patches, brown sturdy boots, small weathered backpack with rolled blanket and metal mug, brown belt pouches. Not cute. Traditional detailed pixel art, crisp deliberate pixel clusters with dark contour, muted warm greys, retain readable lit lower legs. No environment, no ground shadow, no text, no dividers, no labels.
CRITICAL layout: single square image, an invisible regular THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, six fully separated isolated parts centered in their own cells with large transparent gutters, NO overlap or clipping.
Cell top left: HEAD plus complete TORSO and backpack and belt to hips, NO ARMS and NO LEGS, shoulder sockets fully drawn.
Cell top middle: character's complete LEFT LEG alone, from hip through thigh and shin to boot, neutral slightly bent knee, sole horizontal, no torso.
Cell top right: complete RIGHT LEG alone from hip to boot, same length as other leg.
Cell bottom left: complete LEFT ARM alone from shoulder to hand, bent elbow in two-handed rifle holding pose, olive jacket sleeve and bare hand, EMPTY hand; no weapon.
Cell bottom middle: complete RIGHT ARM alone from shoulder to empty hand in trigger grip pose, same materials.
Cell bottom right: ONLY a wood-stock compact carbine viewed in this SAME camera angle and bearing, NO hands, no person, barrel direction specified below, not an icon from a different perspective.
Parts share lighting and scale, need to be reassembled as one character, arms with enough overlap at shoulder and wrist. Face/head remain attached to torso. Weapon MUST be independent of hands and body. Stance natural relaxed upright, not crouched. Camera is fixed orthographic high three-quarter top-down RPG view, about 35 degrees looking down; never rotate the whole illustration flat to fake a turn. Pixel detail should read after torso height becomes about 40 game pixels and legs 25 game pixels. Use the reference only for identity and art style; output ONLY the six parts, not the original whole armed figure.

sources.prompt_direction: Character facing straight AWAY from viewer, north/up on game screen. See back of hair, rear jacket and backpack, NO visible face or chest scarf. Both boots point away. Carbine points straight UP, visibly foreshortened as seen from behind/above.
Rear northeast replacement, triceps/knuckles visible, heels turned away; override prompt supersedes the common template.
sources.prompt_override:
Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT / replacement game sprite asset sheet.
Reference image is the previously generated modular scavenger parts sheet. Keep EXACT same adult brown-haired male character, muted olive rugged jacket, brown trousers, brown boots, worn brown backpack with a rolled blanket and hanging metal mug, same detailed small-game pixel-art palette. However FIX the view consistency. The OLD sheet has wrongly front/side-view arms and sideways feet. Do NOT copy those wrong poses.
Make a transparent sprite construction sheet, THREE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, each component isolated centered inside its own cell with wide transparent gutters. No text or grid lines.
Camera is an orthographic three-quarter RPG camera 35 degrees looking down. Character faces AWAY from viewer and to the RIGHT, northeast. We see his BACK, rear-right shoulder and only a small sliver of right cheek. The FRONT of his chest and the insides of his arms face AWAY from the viewer. The visible nearer shoulder is on screen RIGHT, farther shoulder is on screen LEFT behind backpack.
ROW 1: LEFT cell = torso with head, backpack, complete fully PAINTED CLOSED ROUNDED shoulder caps and belt to hip, without separate long arms or legs. ABSOLUTELY NO BLACK HOLLOW SHOULDER SOCKETS, no circular cutout openings. MIDDLE cell = complete NEAR RIGHT ARM from shoulder cap to empty gripping hand, rear/triceps view, elbow naturally bent down beside right ribs and forearm reaching forward AWAY and RIGHT, back of glove/knuckles visible, not palm. RIGHT cell = FAR LEFT ARM in the same rear northeast view, naturally bent and foreshortened, empty support hand reaching forward away. These arms belong in front of the character's chest in 3D, so the torso will occlude most forearms when assembled; never fold both arms ACROSS THE BACK.
ROW 2: LEFT cell = full near right leg from hip to boot, seen from BEHIND-right, rear thigh seams, rear calf and HEEL facing viewer, toes point away-UP-RIGHT (NOT sideways-right and NOT at viewer). MIDDLE cell = full far left leg same rear-three-quarter view and same length, heel visible. RIGHT cell = separate compact wood-stock carbine in northeast aiming projection, barrel up-right, NO hands or body.
ROW 3: LEFT cell = COMPLETE assembled SAME full character in relaxed LOW-READY carrying that carbine in front of chest/waist AWAY from camera, BOTH ARMS CORRECTLY ATTACHED and foreshortened. MIDDLE cell = COMPLETE assembled SAME full character AIMING the carbine up-right AWAY from viewer, right shoulder into stock, NEAR UPPER ARM visible beside right ribs, forearms/hands correctly in FRONT of chest and therefore mostly HIDDEN BY TORSO from this rear camera; only forward parts protrude past right edge. Back and backpack remain clearly visible and unobstructed by forearms. RIGHT cell = empty transparent space.
Bottom row is a construction reference, upper rows separate usable components. Anatomical coherence of the two complete reference figures is the highest priority. Matching shoulder joins, natural elbows, no severed limbs, no exposed empty shoulder holes, no arms that read as front-facing. Neutral upright standing stance, no crouch. Keep silhouette readable at 64 game pixels full height. Crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no painterly background, no ground shadow, no labels. TRUE TRANSPARENCY.

sources.prompt_direction: Character facing straight TOWARD viewer, south/down on game screen. See full front face, red scarf and front jacket, only backpack straps. Both boot toes point toward viewer. Carbine points DOWN toward viewer, strongly foreshortened, seen from above at an angle, not a horizontal side drawing.

Character facing TOWARD viewer and RIGHT, southeast/down-right on game screen. Front three-quarter view, see front face, scarf, chest and RIGHT side. Carbine points diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, seen foreshortened from above.
